offers.name: Lenovo Legion Pro 5i Gaming Laptop 16" 2560 x 1600 240Hz Intel Ultra 9-290HX Plus up to 5.5 GHz - Nvidia GeForce RTX 5070 12GB GDDR7 - 32GB RAM - 1TB SSD - Windows 11 Home

reviews.quote: It's built well and clean looking, offers solid ergonomics, decent inputs, and a beautiful OLED display that you won't normally find in this segment.
strong raster performance from the RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU, excellent motion clarity from the 240Hz 2560×1600 OLED, and a cooling design that sustains clocks without resorting to gimmicks.
it focuses on nailing the fundamentals: strong performance, a fantastic display, sturdy build quality, and a keyboard that's genuinely comfortable to use.

professional.note: Pro scores are for the tested Ultra 9 275HX / RTX 5070 Ti / 32GB config (NBC collection 86.8%); this tier's ratings inferred per SHARED-legion-pro5.md deltas.

praises: Ultrabook Review explicitly recommends the RTX 5070 tier over the Ti: competitively priced and properly tamed in this chassis
Newest Gen 11 refresh CPU (Ultra 9 290HX Plus) — best CPU of the line at the lowest 5070 Ti-adjacent price
OLED 240Hz panel (assumed per line spec) with inky blacks rare at this tier
Dual SODIMM + dual M.2 — cheap upgrade path to 64GB/4TB+
Runs cooler and quieter than the 5070 Ti tiers while still maxing WQXGA in most titles with DLSS
complaints: 8GB VRAM is the weak spot — new AAA titles at WQXGA max textures can exceed it; the 12GB Ti tier ages better
Some Gen 10 Legion 50-series units hit nvlddmkm TDR black-screen crashes during gaming (platform-wide Legion reports)
Battery is weak — roughly 4h light use; the laptop is a desk machine
Speakers are modest and there are no rear ports
BBY listing omits panel type — verify OLED vs IPS before buying this marketplace-listed SKU

design_philosophy: Lenovo's 'mainstream affordable Legion Pro' bet: take the Pro 7 chassis language, keep the strong 140W-class GPU cooling and comfortable TrueStrike keyboard, and differentiate with an OLED panel rarely seen at this tier — while trimming premium extras (rear I/O, big speaker arrays). This 275HX/5070 Ti/32GB/2TB tier is the sweet-spot config the professional reviewers tested and recommend: standouts = OLED 240Hz + upgradeable RAM/storage; dealbreakers for some = battery life and sale-price-dependent value.
rating_notes: Inferred from anchor 80 per SHARED-legion-pro5.md: RTX 5070 8GB vs 5070 Ti 12GB = -1.2 gaming / -0.5 ai_ml / +0.5 thermals (5070 "properly tamed in this chassis" per Ultrabook Review, who recommends this tier); 290HX Plus +0.2 productivity; 1TB -0.3 creative_work.
